mech-abduction.text: Two mechs rise into the air, carrying Elder Tater away.

bacon-bridge-landing.text: Tatoria drops from above and lands with a thud.

baconator-landing.text: A large man leaps into view. The ground shakes as he lands.

jail-cell.text: A figure steps into view behind the bars.

double-entrance.text: A second mech sweeps in to join the first.

chomps-intervenes.text: Chomps rushes between Wendy and the laser.

mechs-descend.text: Mech Double descends in front of Wendy and Elder Tater.

chomps-arrives.text: A small mech steps out into the chamber.

mech-office-visit.text: Two guards appear with Elder Tater between them.

jail-breach.text: A hole has been smashed through the jail wall. The little mech stands outside.

secret-visitor.text: A figure steps into view near the shrine.

chicken-falls.text: Sir Chicken charges the mechs and is knocked to the ground.

beef-thief-leap.text: Beef Thief leaps at the party.

mech-messenger.text: A small mech rushes into MechBorg's office.

chomps-sacrifice.text: The flash fades. Chomps lies broken on the floor.

anger-mitch.text: A spiral-eyed face appears over Mitch.

anger-megan.text: A spiral-eyed face appears over Megan.

anger-mina.text: A spiral-eyed face appears over Mina.

anger-tatoria.text: A spiral-eyed face appears over Tatoria.

anger-milly.text: A spiral-eyed face appears over Milly.

anger-marge.text: A spiral-eyed face appears over Marge.

anger-mallory.text: A spiral-eyed face appears over Mallory.

anger-magnus.text: A spiral-eyed face appears over Magnus.

anger-mayor.text: A spiral-eyed face appears over the mayor.

anger-mike.text: A spiral-eyed face appears over Mike.

anger-mckay.text: A spiral-eyed face appears over McKay.

anger-monty.text: A spiral-eyed face appears over Monty.

anger-milhouse.text: A spiral-eyed face appears over Milhouse.

anger-chomps.text: A spiral-eyed face appears over Chomps.

anger-kraz.text: A spiral-eyed face appears over Kraz.

anger-son-of-baconator.text: A spiral-eyed face appears over Son of Baconator.

startled-search-and-rescue-officer.text: The search and rescue officer is surprised.

hazy-wendy.text: A dizzy swirl appears over Wendy.

hazy-frostyna.text: A dizzy swirl appears over Frostyna.

hazy-chomps.text: A dizzy swirl appears over Chomps.

puzzled-wendy.text: A question mark appears over Wendy.

puzzled-frygor.text: A question mark appears over Frygor.

puzzled-chomps.text: A question mark appears over Chomps.

puzzled-mech-grunt.text: A question mark appears over the Mech Grunt.

idea-frygor.text: A light bulb appears over Frygor.

idea-wendy.text: A light bulb appears over Wendy.

idea-frostyna.text: A light bulb appears over Frostyna.

idea-veronica.text: A light bulb appears over Veronica.

idea-elder-tater.text: A light bulb appears over Elder Tater.

idea-dave-statue.text: A light bulb appears above the Dave statue.

frustration-golden-archer.text: A dark cloud appears over the Golden Archer.

frustration-frygor.text: A dark cloud appears over Frygor.

frustration-marshell.text: A dark cloud appears over Marshell.

frostyna-idea.text: A light bulb appears over Frostyna.

wendy-door-reaction.text: Wendy pauses. An ellipsis appears over her head.

frostyna-prison-blast.text: Frostyna blasts the bars. The screen flashes and shakes. The bars hold.

wendy-knocks.text: Wendy knocks twice at the prison door.

idle-wendy-glides.text: Wendy glides and bounces off the edges.

idle-stones-appear.text: Four stones appear in the corners.

idle-stones-spin.text: The stones spin at the center.

idle-question.text: A question mark pops up above Wendy.

idle-dozes.text: Zs drift over Wendy’s head as she dozes.

idle-map-dark.text: The map fades to black around Wendy.

idle-stone-pickup.text: A stone jumps to the center when Wendy touches it.

idle-stones-bounce.text: The stones scatter and bounce around the screen.

idle-trails.text: The moving sprites leave trails behind them.

idle-crt.text: Scan lines and grain appear across the screen.

idle-color-split.text: Colored outlines separate around the shapes.

idle-screen-shifts.text: The picture starts stretching and tilting.

underground-staircase.text: The view pans upward to reveal a staircase rising through the cavern.

frostyna-spots-markborg.text: Frostyna turns toward MarkBorg and jumps in alarm. The others turn toward him.

sacred-reward-glow.text: Golden beams shimmer above the treasure chests.

music-dave-statue.text: Musical notes appear over the Dave statue.

music-child.text: Musical notes appear over the child.

party-vanishes.text: Wendy's companions gather into her so the whole party fits on the elevator.

chomps-door-open.text: Chomps has smashed the door open.

double-first-entrance.text: A mech walks in through the open door.

elder-tater-freed.text: The cell opens, freeing Elder Tater.

heart-elder-tater.text: A heart appears over Elder Tater.

heart-mech-grunt.text: A heart appears over the Mech Grunt.

big-mech-reveal.text: A curtain rises, revealing a giant burger-shaped robot.

companions-take-stones.text: Wendy's companions move toward the Corner Stones.

stone-frygor.text: A Corner Stone appears above Frygor.

stone-frostyna.text: A Corner Stone appears above Frostyna.

stone-sir-chicken.text: A Corner Stone appears above Sir Chicken.

stone-baconator.text: A Corner Stone appears above Baconator.

chomps-flash.text: A blinding flash fills the room.

double-mech-transform.text: The Big Mech shudders and flashes as it transforms.

double-mech-crumble.text: The Double Big Mech crumbles into wreckage.

wendy-departure-light.text: Rays of light shine down around Wendy.

epilogue-glitch.text: The screen briefly breaks into sideways-shifting horizontal strips.

double-mech-explosion.text: An explosion rocks the Double Big Mech.

double-mech-explosion-again.text: A second explosion rocks the Double Big Mech.

stones-unite.text: The Corner Stones whirl together and flare with brilliant light.

prologue-islands.text: The view glides across the islands of Savoria.

prologue-emblem.text: MechBorg's emblem: an angular gold M beneath a downward chevron.

prologue-march.text: Rows of Mech Grunts march together.

prologue-ruins.text: The view glides through the ruins.

wendy-wakes.text: Wendy wakes up on the beach.

wendy-arrival-ripple.text: The rippling view clears, revealing Wendy lying on the beach.

elder-tater-shout.text: Elder Tater's shout jolts the screen.

sauce-drains.text: The sauce recedes, exposing the floor.

exclamation-bookcase.text: An exclamation mark appears by the bookcase.

alerted-mech-grunt.text: An exclamation mark appears over the Mech Grunt.

sleeping-wendy.text: Wendy falls asleep with Zs floating over her head.

exclamation-lil-salty.text: An exclamation mark appears over Lil Salty.

exclamation-burnt-lamp.text: An exclamation mark appears over Burnt Lamp.

exclamation-soggy-snake.text: An exclamation mark appears over Soggy Snake.

exclamation-hot-sludge-sundae.text: An exclamation mark appears over Hot Sludge Sundae.

exclamation-heat-lamp.text: An exclamation mark appears over Heat Lamp.

exclamation-golden-archer-plus.text: An exclamation mark appears over Golden Archer plus.

exclamation-axoflopl.text: An exclamation mark appears over Axoflopl.

quiet-sir-chicken.text: Three dots appear over Sir Chicken.

discovery-question.text: A question mark appears over the newly revealed location.

assistance-chest.text: A treasure chest appears in front of Dave's statue.

momentum-collected.text: A momentum crystal bounces into the Momentum meter.

momentum-full.text: A momentum crystal bounces, then vanishes in a starburst.

skill-crispy-shield.text: Frygor plants a shield of giant fries around Wendy.

skill-rise-shine.text: A golden beam shines down around Wendy.

skill-frosty-time.text: Frostyna summons an ice cream clock with spinning hands.

skill-frosty-blast.text: A giant swirl of ice cream engulfs the target.

skill-crispy-barrage.text: Frygor rains giant fries onto the enemies, bursting on impact.

skill-pigtail-whip.text: Wendy spins, lashing her target with her long pigtails.

skill-beef-attack.text: Wendy darts through the enemies, slashing rapidly with her spatulas.

skill-nugget-strike.text: Chicken nuggets erupt across the ground toward Sir Chicken's target.

skill-guard.text: Wendy braces behind her crossed spatulas.

ice-machine-arrives.text: The Ice Cream Machine leaps into view, landing with a crash that shakes the ground.

shrine-lights.text: The lights switch on, revealing the shrine.

shrine-reunion.text: A white flash fills the shrine. Wendy's companions appear beside her.

grunt-ambush.text: Mech Grunts march in around the party.

party-jailed.text: The party has been captured. Wendy and her companions stand behind bars in Mech Jail.

ability-upgrade.text: A white flash fills the screen as it shakes.

map-closes.text: The map slides out of view.

map-wendy.text: Wendy's marker drops onto the map and bounces.

map-quest.text: A quest marker drops onto the map and bounces.

map-marks.text: Pink symbols mark locations on the atlas.

officer-aside.text: Gregg hops out of the way.

companions-reappear.text: Wendy's companions reappear, with Baconator among them.

office-lights-on.text: The lights come back on, revealing a hooded figure ahead.

mech-shield-vanishes.text: The gold lattice shielding the Double Big Mech vanishes.

double-mech-whiteout.text: White light engulfs the Double Big Mech.

hp-healing-sparkles.text: Sparkles circle the HP meter as it fills.
